engineeringSkip.reason: Neutron-degenerate matter is only stable under neutron-star gravity and cannot be stabilised at low pressure by any known or theoretically plausible engineering, so 'neutronium alloys' are pseudo-science rather than a technology.

factCheck.reason: Neutron-degenerate matter only exists squeezed inside neutron stars by gravity, and no known force or 'femto-scale engineering' could hold it together in a lab — a spoonful would instantly fly apart, so 'neutronium alloys' as an engineering material contradicts established physics.
